faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to the most frequently asked questions about our IPTV service.

q1.q: What is IPTV and how does it work?
q1.a: IPTV (Internet Protocol Television) is a service that delivers television channels via the internet rather than traditional methods (cable/satellite). You only need a stable internet connection and a compatible device to access it.

q2.q: What devices are compatible with your service?
q2.a: Our service is compatible with most devices: Smart TV (Samsung, LG, Sony, Android TV), Amazon Firestick, MAG boxes, smartphones/tablets (iOS and Android), computers (PC/Mac), and Apple TV.

q3.q: What internet speed do I need?
q3.a: For a smooth streaming experience, we recommend a minimum connection speed of 12 Mbps for HD channels, 20 Mbps for Full HD, and 30-40 Mbps for optimal quality in 4K UHD.

q4.a: Activation is extremely fast. Once payment is confirmed, you will receive your access codes and the complete installation guide by email in less than 5 minutes.

q5.q: Can I use the subscription on multiple devices?
q5.a: Each standard subscription allows one active connection at a time. If you wish to use it on multiple screens simultaneously, please contact our customer support for a preferential multi-screen rate.

q6.q: Do you offer a refund if I am not satisfied?
q6.a: Yes, absolutely. We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you experience a technical problem or are not satisfied, contact us via WhatsApp to request a refund.
